title: Chickpeas Across the Day: Breakfast Hash, Buffalo Chickpea Sandwich, One-Pot Curry, and Aquafaba Chocolate Mousse
summary: In this Goodful video hosted by Merle, chickpeas are showcased as a versatile, plant-based protein across four meals. The breakfast segment builds a colorful roasted vegetable hash with sweet potatoes, mushrooms, onions, and peppers, finished with a sriracha-tahini dressing. Lunch features a buffalo chickpea sandwich paired with a vegan ranch dressing and fresh veggies. Dinner centers on a homey, one-pot vegan curry built from aromatics, garam masala, turmeric, tomatoes, and chickpeas, simmered into a thick stew. For dessert, the aquafaba (chickpea water) is whipped into stiff peaks and folded with melted chocolate, sugar, and vanilla to create a mousse. The host emphasizes color for nutrition, offers customizable options (e.g., substituting tofu, serving with rice or naan), and provides precise timing and temperatures for roasting and simmering throughout the recipes.

sections.title: Breakfast hash with roasted vegetables and chickpeas
concepts: dicing sweet potato; variety of vegetables (mushrooms, onion, peppers)
oven preheat and roasting (425F; later 475-500F for finish)
seasoning: olive oil, paprika, garlic powder, salt; optional red pepper flakes
sections.description: Merle introduces chickpeas and demonstrates a breakfast hash built from diced sweet potatoes, mushrooms, onions, and peppers. Vegetables are roasted, with timing guidance for two-stage roasting, and a quick tahini–sriracha dressing is prepared to finish the dish. The segment emphasizes nutrient-dense, colorful ingredients and customization.

sections.title: Buffalo chickpea sandwich with vegan ranch dressing
concepts: chickpeas mixed with vegan buffalo sauce
vegan mayonnaise; garlic powder; onion powder; salt; pepper
vegan ranch dressing: mayo, non-dairy milk, apple cider vinegar, lemon juice, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, salt, pepper; parsley and dill optional
sections.description: Lunch option combines a spicy buffalo chickpea mixture with a creamy vegan ranch. The dressing is prepared separately, then the sandwich is assembled with vegetables such as onion and tomato and greens. The segment highlights quick assembly and vegan alternatives.

sections.title: One-pot vegan curry

spices: garam masala, turmeric; salt and pepper
add tomatoes, chickpeas, water; scrape bottom for flavor
simmer ~15 minutes; adjust with more water
finish with lemon juice; cilantro optional
sections.description: Dinner option is a single-pot curry featuring a classic aromatics base and warm spices. The method emphasizes deglazing the pan to lift browned bits, simmering until thickened, and a bright finish with citrus. Serving suggestions include rice and naan.

sections.title: Aquafaba chocolate mousse (dessert)
concepts: aquafaba whipped to stiff peaks with a hand mixer
fold in melted chocolate, sugar, vanilla
portion into cups and chill 3 hours or overnight
sections.description: Dessert uses aquafaba from canned chickpeas as a vegan alternative to eggs. The mousse is formed by whipping until stiff peaks and gently folding in chocolate, sugar, and vanilla, then chilling before serving.
